caption:
A needle wedged between two lines isn't a weight, it's a guess.

A bathroom scale gets bought once and used for years, so a clear number matters more than it seems. Digital removes the angle-reading, squint-at-the-dial guesswork of the old kind.

The Etekcity Digital Body Weight Bathroom Scale does one job: show a number, no setup required. 348,951 reviews averaging 4.7 stars is enough data to say that holds up past a lucky first batch of reviews.

At $19.88, it's a low-risk way to stop guessing at your own weight.
